name: Voice Listening
description: Acoustic perception: wake-word detection, continuous speech recognition, and acoustic environment classification.

settings.ATENA_ONLINE_STT_MODEL: Custom server: model name (e.g. google/gemma-3n-E4B-it or whisper-large-v3)

help.ATENA_MIC_AGC: Automatic: ATENA measures your voice and, if the microphone is too loud or distorts, it turns on the browser volume control by itself, which lowers the microphone in the system. Yes: always on. No: never.
help.ATENA_ONLINE_STT_URL: Any server with the OpenAI-compatible transcription API (/v1/audio/transcriptions). The API key is optional.
